desc: Cosmetic: the B0 boot prints ~13 'sysctl: error: ... is an unknown key' lines for net/ipv4/*, net/ipv6/* and kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled, because the DIET kernel disables CONFIG_NET and BPF while Alpine's stock /etc/sysctl.conf (and sysctl.d) still reference those keys. Trim the sysctl config in scripts/t6040-build-alpine-b0.sh (or drop the sysctl service from the boot runlevel) so the untethered boot is clean. Offline, small; rebuild initramfs + object and re-pin hashes.
author: claude
